_comment: BlankTB Portal Backend Egg - FastAPI + MongoDB (self-healing)
author: blankthedeer@gmail.com
name: BlankTB Backend
description: FastAPI backend for the BlankTB Portal with MongoDB and Discord webhook alerts. Includes auto-healing Git sync support.
startup: if [ ! -d backend ]; then echo 'Backend folder missing, recloning repo...'; git clone https://{{GITHUB_PAT}}@github.com/BlankTheDeer/gba.git .; fi && cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port {{SERVER_PORT}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update -y
apt install -y git python3 python3-pip
cd /mnt/server

echo "--- Cloning BlankTB Backend Repository ---"
git clone https://{{GITHUB_PAT}}@github.com/BlankTheDeer/gba.git .
cd backend

pip install -r requirements.txt

echo "--- Backend Setup Complete ---"

variables.name: GITHUB_PAT
variables.description: GitHub Personal Access Token (read-only) for accessing the private backend repository.

variables.name: MONGO_URI
variables.description: MongoDB connection URI provided by Pelican's database feature.

variables.name: MAIL_SERVER
variables.description: Mail server hostname (for support tickets and password resets).

variables.name: MAIL_PASS
variables.description: Mail server password or app token.

variables.name: DISCORD_ALERT_WEBHOOK
variables.description: Discord webhook for backend status alerts.

variables.name: DISCORD_UPTIME_WEBHOOK
variables.description: Discord webhook for uptime summary reports.
